Resourceful Rebar is a finishing crafting reagent that can increase Resourcefulness while crafting items from most Midnight professions. Its effectiveness is increased with crafting stats, up to a maximum of 20 Resourcefulness. It can be obtained by fulfilling Crafting Orders or by opening an Artisan's Consortium Payout. 5 of them can be combined to form a Resourceful Routing.

Resourceful Routing is a finishing crafting reagent that can increase Resourcefulness while crafting items from most Midnight professions. It can be obtained by fulfilling Crafting Orders, by opening an Artisan's Consortium Payout, or by combining 5 Resourceful Rebar.

Riding Along (or just Ride Along) is a passenger feature for some skyriding-capable mounts. Players in groups can right click on another member's mount to "ride-along" with them as a smaller variant of the mount (such as a dragon whelp for a dragon mount). This feature can be enabled or disabled via a choice node in the Skyriding Skill Track. During , this feature could be enabled or disabled by visiting a Dragonriding Trainer such as Lithragosa in Valdrakken.

The Ring of Containment is the central hub of Uldir, entered by heading north from the Hall of Sanitation after defeating MOTHER. It consists of a long walkway that runs in a roughly octagonal ring around a vast, fog-filled pit, with the Oblivion Door as a low platform in the center. Players need to defeat the bosses in three small wings branching out from the Ring of Containment—Zek'voz in the Archives of Eternity (west), Vectis in the Plague Vault (north), and the Fetid Devourer in the Gallery of Failures (east)—in order to allow MOTHER to reactivate their vault consoles and raise three stairways that allow players to cross the pit and reach the Oblivion Door.
